facts.fact: Eden 在 Oliver 床上醒来，第一反应恐慌、看见睡脸后第二轮恐慌。
facts.anchor: When I roll over and find Oliver’s sleeping face inches away from me, my second thought is to also panic.

facts.fact: 摸到辫子才想起昨晚：她自嘲这双手能开质谱仪、绝不会编发。
facts.anchor: These hands can use state-of-the-art mass spectrometry machines but do not ask me to braid.

facts.fact: 冷静下来的账：下周三份作业，一想他就学不进去——她早知道会这样。
facts.anchor: I’ve got three assignments due next week and I can barely concentrate without thinking about him.

facts.fact: 逃跑逻辑三连：不能让他失望、不能放手、但必须放手——对两人都好。
facts.anchor: I can’t let him down. I can’t let him go. But I have to.

facts.fact: Oliver 醒来满嘴她的唇彩味，还想劝她以后多穿红色。
facts.anchor: The taste of Eden’s lip gloss is still on my mouth when I wake up the next morning.

facts.fact: 他抓包她偷溜并提议做早餐，心里直打鼓：怕这提议越线、怕她说不。
facts.anchor: I’m worried that this offer might be too much.

facts.fact: 弟弟 Jake 视频乱入，听见男声便断定 Eden 有男友，扬言马上告诉妈妈。
facts.anchor: Eden has a boyfriend! Just wait until I tell Mum.

facts.fact: Eden 家务农：爸爸替别人的奶牛场打工，妈妈在镇上小学教书——她感恩家人理解她不要他们的人生。
facts.anchor: Dad works for someone else’s dairy farm and Mum works at the local primary school.

facts.fact: 高中后再没带男孩回家过——唯一一段也只维持一个月，家人总催她「出去走走」。
facts.anchor: I haven’t brought a boy home since high school. And even then, we only dated for a month.
